itemdesc-metalbowl-copper: A simple upgrade from traditional clay. It holds 2 servings and keeps food fresh 10% longer (0.9x perish rate).
itemdesc-metalbowl-tinbronze: A reliable bronze bowl for daily use. It holds 3 servings and keeps food fresh 15% longer (0.85x perish rate).
itemdesc-metalbowl-iron: A heavy and sturdy iron bowl. It holds 4 servings and keeps meals fresh 20% longer (0.8x perish rate).
itemdesc-metalbowl-steel: An advanced steel bowl built for the road. It holds 5 servings and slows down food decay by 25% (0.75x perish rate).
itemdesc-metalbowl-goldplatedsteel: A rare masterpiece of culinary luxury. It holds 6 servings and cuts food decay exactly in half (0.5x perish rate).
itemdesc-metalcookingpot-copper: A basic metal pot that handles heat better than clay. It holds 8 servings, cooks meals 10% faster (0.9x cooking time), and reduces food decay by 10%.
itemdesc-metalcookingpot-tinbronze: A sturdy camp companion. It holds 10 servings, cooks meals 20% faster (0.8x cooking time), and reduces food decay by 15%.
itemdesc-metalcookingpot-iron: A heavy-duty cauldron for large families. It holds 12 servings, cooks meals 30% faster (0.7x cooking time), and reduces food decay by 20%.
itemdesc-metalcookingpot-steel: An industrial-grade pot meant to feed a settlement. It holds 16 servings, cooks meals 40% faster (0.6x cooking time), and reduces food decay by 25%.
itemdesc-metalcookingpot-goldplatedsteel: The ultimate culinary artifact. It holds a massive 20 servings, cooks meals 3 times faster (0.33x cooking time), and cuts food decay in half (0.5x perish rate).
